description: This Go source file defines the VCStorage struct and associated methods for managing verifiable credentials (VCs) within a storage backend, including storing, retrieving, and listing VCs and workflow VCs, as well as converting between stored metadata and full VC data.

classes.name: VCStorage
classes.description: A struct providing methods to manage verifiable credentials and workflow VCs using a storage provider.

methods.name: NewVCStorageWithStorage
methods.description: Constructor for VCStorage, initializes with a given storage provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs a lightweight check to verify storage provider availability.

methods.name: StoreExecutionVC
methods.description: Stores an execution verifiable credential into storage.

methods.name: GetExecutionVC
methods.description: Retrieves a single execution VC by its ID.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCsByWorkflow
methods.description: Fetches all execution VCs associated with a specific workflow.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCsBySession
methods.description: Fetches all execution VCs associated with a specific session.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCByExecutionID
methods.description: Fetches the most recent VC for a specific execution ID.

methods.name: QueryExecutionVCs
methods.description: Runs a filtered query for execution VCs.

methods.name: ListWorkflowVCStatusSummaries
methods.description: Provides aggregated VC statistics for given workflow IDs.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowVC
methods.description: Stores metadata for a workflow-level VC.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVC
methods.description: Retrieves the latest VC for a specific workflow.

methods.name: ListWorkflowVCs
methods.description: Lists all workflow VCs.

methods.name: DeleteExecutionVC
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting an execution VC (not implemented).

methods.name: DeleteWorkflowVC
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting a workflow VC (not implemented).

methods.name: GetVCStats
methods.description: Returns simple metrics/stats about stored VCs.

methods.name: convertVCInfoToExecutionVC
methods.description: Converts stored VC info into a full ExecutionVC object with document and signature loaded.

methods.name: convertWorkflowVCInfo
methods.description: Converts stored workflow VC info into a full WorkflowVC object.

methods.name: loadExecutionVCsFromDatabaseWithFilters
methods.description: Loads execution VCs matching specific filters from the storage provider.

methods.name: getFullVCFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves the full VC document and signature from storage given a VC ID.

methods.name: getFullVCFromLocalStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the VC payload from local SQLite storage.
